balls.text: Short on off, pulled to deep midwicket
Along the carpet through cover point. Jadeja continues to have fun with Shardul, has a few words and pumps the air. The playful dancing continues. Was a wide length ball, cut hard by Jadeja
Free hit brings up 200. Nearly a six over midwicket. Flat pull to a short slow ball on leg stump

Taken at cover. Shardul pumps his fist and smiles at Jadeja but uno reverse happens as the siren goes off. Jadeja pumped his fists and went come on!!! Wide and slowish, slapped to cover. Shardul overstepped

Misfield. They sneak back for two, oh wow, they're taking a third too! Shortish ball outside off, pulled to deep midwicket's left. Jadeja had run one and a half by the time SKY fumbled. Long-on ran in as the batters scampered
Shortish ball outside off, cut to deep point
Beaten. Into the pitch, wide and slow. Jadeja got his back leg well outside off and looked to cut it. Missed
Slot ball has been pumped. Over straight long-on. Angling in towards off, Burger gets low and munches a drive with full follow-through
Full around sixth stump, driven to long-off
Wide slow full toss has been slapped through cover point. Wide yorker gone wrong and Jadeja capitalises

Length on off, chopped to deep third. Should've just been a single but Jadeja charged for two. Hardik not happy. He ran in and threw it flat, not full power (maybe there's a shoulder issue) and well to the keeper's right. Rickelton was in front of the stumps and didn't look to take off the bails. He didn't realise Jadeja was running back
Wide and full, jammed to deep backward point's left. Fielder swoops in quickly
Pitched up outside off, driven to Hardik's right at mid-off. He flings the ball under-arm at the striker's

Down leg, not called wide. Jadeja reviews. His back knee was nearly on the ground and well outside off, front foot was on leg stump as he got low for the scoop. The back-of-length ball went past bat and down leg. Given wide

Archer's got a few good straight hits to balls that were dug in. Goes for it again, finds long-on. 114ks short ball wide of off, spongy bounce takes it around shoulder-height. Archer flat-batted it to Tilak's left
Short and slow on leg, pulled to deep square leg

Taken at long-on. Shardul went slow and into the pitch outside off. The towel clinging onto Shardul's trousers fell off in the run-up but Shubham went through with the swipe across the line. He picked out long-on as it went off the bottom of the bat. As he walks off, Kumar Sangakkara keeps him in the playing area while chatting to a match official, likely regarding the towel. Dead ball not rewarded. Batter walks off
Wide and into the pitch, carved to deep cover point

Change in length goes wrong for Shardul. Full toss called no ball for height. It was flat and on leg stump, Archer stood in the crease and looked to help it away with a whip, luckily he did it fine and in the gap to the left of short 45
Into the pitch, rifled away. Slower bouncer angling away from around the wicket, towards off stump. Archer opens himself up slightly and pulls it just in front of square
Wide on a back of length, cut to long-off
Pitched up on leg, beats the flick and goes off the pad behind square. Soft lbw appeal turned down, no review taken. Seemed too straight
Better timing on the straight drive, clears the infield and gets it to long-off's right. Bosch going for the yorker, undercooks it
Tilak runs in from long-off... and gets half-volleyed. He palms the ball in and keeps it to two. Low full toss on off, Archer swung through the line, bat-face opened on impact

Swung across the line. Teaser... lands safely. Just over the ropes. Deep midwicket and square leg converged but it went between them. Slot ball around middle and leg, Archer closing the face fully and swiping across

Perfect yorker. Around off stump, Archer couldn't get underneath it despite the big back-lift. Wanted to jam it to cover, gets it off the edge to midwicket. Luckily, it went slow and there was no infielder
Length around off, punched to cover for a quick single

Home run? Yes, despite SKY's valiant effort to cut it off at at long-off. He was leaping back, looked to lob the ball in but it parried further back. It was wide to his right too, which didn't help. Short and slow outside off, baseball-style swipe across his chest from Archer
Archer gives up and gets away as there's no direct hit. Momentary miscommunication between batters doesn't cost them. Back of length just outside off, punched to mid-off.
Pulled to deep square leg's right. Short just outside off, pulled into the ground with control. Hits the gap too

Chahar compensates and strikes. He goes short, slow and wide after missing the yorker and getting hit for six. Short ball dug in wide, Ferreira did go slightly across but was using his hands mostly to reach for the pull. Cloths it to long-on
Full toss has been short-arm driven over long-on. Ferreira goes outside off and is right beside the shin-high full toss, he goes back in the crease and muscles it 80 metres far as Chahar grimaces
Wide and full, slashy square drive over the infield to deep cover's left
Pitched up on middle, looks to slog. Gets it along the ground to deep midwicket's left
Back-foot flick to wide long-on. Length ball on leg from slightly wide of the crease
Thumped wide of long-on. Slot ball on leg, Ferreira cleared the front leg and drove cleanly
Full on middle, pushed to long-on
Goes back and flicks it to long-on
Length on leg, defended to the bowler's right
Pulled to deep midwicket's left. Very short again, touch wider, pulled early. Minz stops it. 119ks
Pulled to deep midwicket. Very short ball just outside off, hit from neck-height
Under-edge to the keeper's right, on the bounce. Archer looked to carve a short, wide ball through point. Wanted to go aerial. Good low stop from Ricketlon
Shortish outside off, cut to long-off. Ferreira went hard at that. 121ks
Length on off, defended to the bowler
Fuller side of length in the channel, defended to cover
Looks to push it through point, edges it back to the bowler. Yorker just outside off, Archer a bit too early on it. RR take the timeout right away
Middle and off splattered! 132ks yorker on middle and off. Footwork fails Jurel as he looks to flick it with a closed face. Falls over as he gets beaten on the off side
Length on off, worked to long-on
Gets across and pulls to deep midwicket. Slower one, 121ks, outside off
Ball looked to have straightened in the air. Ferreira is on middle stump and inside the line of the length ball as he defends to point
Pulled to deep-backward square's right. Short and straight from Bosch, didn't get much bounce or pace off the pitch
Pitched up on off, 93ks, defended to the bowler's right. Ghazanfar closes okay, might be the end of his quota
Full and quick on leg, smothers it to long-on. Jurel wanted to go squarer, over-hit it
Sits up and gets pulled. Ghazanfar being taken apart. This was short and slow on middle and leg, Jurel got low and swirled to go over midwicket

Wide on a length, Jurel goes back and cuts to SKY's right at backward point. He was standing close, collected it on the second go and threw to the keeper. Jurel ran back after taking a couple of steps down.
Shovelled fine, beats short-45 to the left. A touch too short and down leg, Jurel essentially reverse-drives it with a twirl in
Cannoned back, Ghazanfar was ready to sacrifice a finger. Threw his right hand up, luckily ball went past him. Was lobbed up too full, Jurel stood beside the ball and drove straight and flat
Pitched up just outside off, punched to cover
Length in the channel, punched to cover
Low full toss on middle and leg, Jurel gets inside the line and plinks a flick past the bowler

Shanaka runs a run and three quarters back before getting run out. Looked like it was the non-striker's call. Shanaka watched Jurel guide a length ball to backward point and took off. Jurel took a step or two, ball-watched and ran back. Shardul fumbled but had ample time to pick his end and send a low, comfy throw to Bosch.
Chopped fine. Could've been chopped on. Jurel looking too pull a short-of-length ball from fourth stump. Doesn't bounce much, under stump-height it was. Took the under-edge and went wide of leg stump
Pitched up on fourth, seemed slow, flicked between deep midwicket and long-on. Not slow it turns out, 141ks
Slower 'un, kept on a length outside off. Shanaka waits forever to let this one come to him, then flicks across the line to get it down to cow corner

Shanaka's guided this into the stands! He's played this sooo fine, over deep fine leg. Was a well-directed bouncer, right at him. But he just gets his head out of the way and swipes at this, helping it along the way. Shardul throws both hands in the air - he knows he didn't do much wrong there
Jurel bashes this down to deep cover. Way too short and way too wide, but Jurel's not been able to find the ropes here
Hits the Nataraja pose and pulls this down to deep square leg! Was a short ball outside off, Shanaka did well to jump on top of this
Late glide down to point. Was on a length outside off, batter waited for this to play it late, deep in his crease
On a length, drive down to covers
Pulls the length back outside off, spins away from the batter looking to run down the pitch and cut this. Mistimes this into the turf, then out to point
Shanaka presses the replay button, off his previous six! Was way too full, Shanaka shuffles into the leg side and swipes across the line. Clean hit over the cow corner ropes
Now the bowler goes for a more defensive line. Was flighted up outside off, right on the wide marker and quite full. Driven down to deep extra cover
Great, classical spin bowling. On a length, drops in after flight, and spins away. Batter can only defend this back to the fielder
Bashing cut but down to point! RR just can't find the gaps against the spinners here, it seems. Was on a length and spinning away
Flicked down to deep midwicket once more. On the front foot against a length ball, at the stumps
Now a casual flick down to deep midwicket, running in to collect this. Was on a length and spinning in once more
Pulls the length back, spinning in from outside off. Driven down to covers once more

Now that's one way to get going against the spinners! Was in the slot, to be fair. Shanaka has immensely long levers and just fetches this from in front of the stumps and shovels this over the long-on ropes. Impeccable touch on that one
Now driven out to deep extra cover. Was on a length and outside off. Consistent, predictable lines here, but batters haven't been able to run away
Drifting down leg and umpire deems no bat or pad on this. Was going for the flick but thuds into keeper's gloves and runs down to deep fine leg

Now Jurel cuts this late, but MI are sharp on the field today! Shardul dives at backward point to stop thisfrom running to the empty ropes. The delivery was on a length outside off, there to be hit once more, but can't get it past the fielder
On a length and spins back in, flicked down to long-on
Shanaka's swept this fine! But straight to deep fine leg. Was on a length and at the stumps. Shanaka got down on one knee in a jiffy, but couldn't place it on either side of the fielder
Jurel drives it down to deep extra cover, standing way inside the ropes. Was full and on the stumps, there to be driven
Threaded through the line, but great fielding at deep extra cover! Ball was floated up outside off, Jurel carries through with the drive, but fielder saves two
Keeps it on a teasing length outside off, driven down to covers once more
Floated in quite full once more. Driven out to deep cover now
Full-ish outside off, driven late but straight to point

And Tilak cuts Parag's innings shot! Parag honestly looks locked in, plays another great shot off a length ball outside off. But guess what: Tilak is stationed at a veryyy straight long-on spot, right on the ropes. He bounces on one knee near the stumps and pounces on this with both hands. A review, for formality's sake, but Parag has to walk back. The umpire had just one look at the replay, though... He deems it enough to flash "OUT" on the screen

Parag's mistimed this inside-out shot, but there's absolutely no one near deep point. Ball thuds into the ropes. Was in the slot once more, kept way outside off, Parag slides into the leg side and thumps this
Way too full, right on the stumps. Parag stands still and lets this come to him, then lofts this under his eyes. Swiped down to cow corner
Ball is gripping here. Lands outside off, driven out to covers and runs to the other end
Carrom ball deposited over cow corner! Was too short outside off, and Jurel swings across the line. Punishes the half-tracker off the backfoot
Quite full first up, right outside off. Can only drive this down to covers
Another great bouncer, another miss! Parag flies with one foot in the air and he can't get bat on ball. 124 kph.
Now he runs down the pitch and bowler follows up with a smart bouncer. Parag goes for a straight-bat tennis-style swat across the line. Misses the line of the ball completely
Parag's flicked the 'On' switch here! Swings across the line with panache, a front-foot pull that is barreling over cow corner. Was on a length outside off and he's connected with this perfectly
Fuller now, on the stumps. Drives this down to midwicket
Parag goes for a late glide behind the square, and misses. Was a short ball and kept slowww, just scoots past Parag. They discuss a review but keeper isn't interested, skipper isn't too

Sooryavanshi has to depart early today! He has had enough waiting at the other end. Was there to be hit, on a length and moving away. Soorya misreads how well he can swing through the line. Tries to loft this over long on but sends out an edge down to backward point. Naman Dhir gobbles this one up, running in
On a length, Jurel crouches in his crease and plays a late glide down to backward point
On a length and well outside off, great turn back into the stumps. Jurel can only drive it out to covers

He's mistimed this straight to point, Corbin Bosch catches Jaiswal out! Impeccable bowling from Jacks, 89 kph this. He keeps this on a perfect length, outside off, tempts Jaiswal to stay in his crease but still go for this. The shot, instead of flying down the ground, flies out to Bosch
And now he's down on one knee. He drives this down to point, but fielder there to collect

Jaiswal's had enough on the waiting game. If it's a good length ball, he'll convert it into a slot ball. He runs down the pitch and just drives this through the line. Huge lofted shot, and it flies over the long-off ropes
On a length at the stumps, spinning back into Soorya's pads. He flicks this down to deep midwicket
Jacks returns for his second over, starts with a wide travelling quite far down the leg side

What's happened here? Was speared into the blockhole once more. But not quite, so Jaiswal could probably drive this. What he does instead is go for the scoop, his legs stretched wide. Ball thuds into his bottom edge and Jaiswal thuds flat on the crease. Stands up again, but no run scored
Slower 'un and a bouncer. Jaiswal tries to go for the ramp but misses it because of how slowwww it is, coming to him

Jaiswal's somehow driven this out to deep cover! Looked way too full to get under this, but Jaiswal treats this like a half-volley. Huge swing through the line and the ball drills along the ground and out to the vacant ropes
Another one in the blockhole, speared in on a fifth-stump line. Sooryavanshi crouches to glide this down to deep backward point
Back of a length and climbing into Jasiwal once more. Easy flick down to midwicket

Jaiswal has launched into outer space for a few moments! Was in the slot, right in the stumps. Knuckle ball. Jaiswal followed through with this bunt down the ground and sends it deep into the stands, 76 metres
Impeccable yorker! Whaddanover from Will Jacks. Sooryavanshi was shuffling into the leg side, but Jacks follows him and fires this right at his toes. Batter tucks it back to the bowler
Now that's a clear wide. On a length but drifting wayyyy down leg. Soorya lets it go.
On a length at the stumps. Batter on the backfoot as he tucks this down to midwicket

Big shout but umpire unmoved. Was speared in a little fuller, spins into the pads, past Jaiswal's attempt at a drive. MI decide to review: the question is whether it is bouncing over the stumps or not, methinks. The replays take a fair while to pop up... No edge, for sure. Umpire's call on the bounce! Close escape for Jaiswal. Schrodinger's bails come in to save the day, agony from Will Jacks, with his floppy hat on.
Clever from Jacks. He pulls it off. Was on a length but kept right on the wide marker. Jaiswal raises his glove in inquiry but it's within the tramline
Straying into the pads, slightly fuller too. An easy tuck towards long-on for a single
Jaiswal plays a thumping drive but straight to point... Pitched on a good length just outside off, Jaiswal plays this cut from right under his eyes, with great skill, but couldn't place it better
Better length. On a length, moving into his pads. Jumps on this delivery and tucks it down to mid-wicket
Now he's sent this wayyyy over the ropes. Not even in the slot completely, but outside off and sitting up for Jaiswal's booming lofted drive. Sent over the long off with no fuss
Back of a length and thuds into Jaiswal's stomach. Swung back into him and he missed the pull, all ends up

Almost Soorya's 54th six in the IPL... But remarkable save by Will Jacks at deep extra cover! Jaiswal swings through the line on this delivery, in the slot outside off. Surely it's flying over the ropes, except Jacks leaps in the air and throws it back in, even as he tumbles over the ropes. Superman save in the afternoon heat
On a length and swinging into Jaiswal's pads, who flicks this down to cow corner and takes off for the other end
Keeps it on the fuller side but well outside off. Jaiswal happy to let this one go
Full outside off, beats the reverse scoop and the keeper throws it down back to the bowler. With that, RR will take on SRH in the Eliminator
Near yorker just outside off, driven over the bowler. Long-off moves right and stops it
Gets across and drills the full ball to long-on
Swipes across, the wide yorker smothers beneath the bat and bounces behind the stumps.
Full outside off, gets on one knee and slog sweeps to long-on. Single not taken
All mathematical possibilities done now! RR will go through to the playoffs! Full and wide, slow ball is driven through extra cover
Nearly hits off stump! Game over though. Mathematically impossible to win in game-time without extras now. Low full toss, Ghazanfar swipes across and misses
Not for now. Slow, full and wide, driven to deep cover. Pulled the power out, might've realised the lack of pace late
Length on off, punched to cover point to bring Shardul on strike

Chahar walks back before the umpire raises his finger. He has reviewed, likely on Shardul's suggestion. Continues to walk as the replay comes on. Dipping low full toss on off. Chahar played across the line, looked to go square and was too early into the shot. Hit on the outer-half of the front shin with half of off-stump visible. Impact on middle and off and hitting middle, according to Hawk-Eye
Swing and a miss. RR surely winning this. Wide on a length, Chahar reached out with his hands and looked to slap it across
Near-yorker around off, smothered along the ground to long-on
Back of length angling away on fourth, Chahar too early into the swipe aimed over mid-on. Seemed slow
This one's off the middle! Back of length outside off, rises under waist-height and Chahar pulls it over long-on. HIt from in front of the body

One more? Archer tries his darnedest but can't cling on! His knee slides into the ground and he then bounces, turns up and yells in frustration. More frustration than pain it turns out as he's okay. Was a wide ball on a back of length, Chahar went for the pull, got it off the upper-half

That's the game done you gotta think. SKY's way too early into the shot and the ball flutters off the toe of the bat to Burger. He turns left in his follow-through and takes it to his left. Slower one into the pitch outside off, SKY looked for the pull
Short slower ball sponges down leg. Did RR review or now? Confusion. They haven't.
Pitched up around off, whipped to long-on. No boundary since 14.1, that's 19 balls

Wide called. Burger puzzled as Shardul moved across a touch. Parag reviews but is too late. Was a short ball that was close to the return crease. Shardul was slightly outside off as he reached out and leapt for the cut
Low bounce beats the pull. Sharp angle away on the back of length ball that landed just outside off. Shardul went across and looked to pull it across. Got beaten on the under-edge
Extra bounce. Shardul got hard with the flat-bat, toe-edges it to long-off. Archer again, keeps it to one. Shortish ball spinning away outside off
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket

Rifled straight, great save from Archer. Runs right from long-off, palms the ball in and slides. Gets back, runs in and throws. Whataneffort! Wide and fullish ball, Thakur heaving his bat across to get it into the ground
Bosch slog sweeps and finds Ferreira! 94ks shortish ball on off, Bosch not fully on one knee as he slog sweeps on the rise. Chunks it to the right of the deep-midwicket fielder
Makes room and drives to deep point. Length on middle and leg, good bounce, SKY was foot-tapping before getting still
Short googly on middle and off. Big spin in, Bosch uses it to pull to deep midwicket
Back of length on fourth, punched through cover. Archer and Bosch share a smile. Brilliant spell ends. Could well have turned the game now
Pitched up in the channel, driven to mid-off

Hardik's cameo is over, he walks back head down! Archer is hobbling with head down too but he's done his job. No real celebrations from the players but Sangakkara claps once enthusiastically. Shortish ball outside off, Hardik hurried on the pull. Got it off the top-half to long-on
Over-hits a pull to deep square leg's left. SKY late to finish the run, fielder bulleted a throw. Archer gets hit on the back of the left ankle. He's okay to continue
Into the pitch, beats bat. Rapid and over middle and off, SKY looks to pull behind square. Twirls and misses
Back of length slung away outside off, flat-batted to long-off
Back of length around off, short-arm pulled to deep midwicket. Timeout taken.
Good stop at backward point by Burger. Moved right and slid through. Wide and fullish, cut nicely despite the bottom hand coming off
Length in the channel, 131ks, driven to long-off
Low full toss outside off, driven to cover
Looks to drive through mid-off, chunks it to long-on
Scoopage! Vintage Orthodox SKY. Fullish length ball on leg, he gets across and on one knee to lift it fine. Hardik points up
Wide on a length, 120ks, slapped to deep point
Upper-cut beaten. SKY leapt and looked to go over the first-slip area. The short ball beat bat. Looked slow, not sure. One for the over called
Length on middle, gets inside the line and flicks to deep-backward square
Back of length just outside off, dribbled towards point with a vertical bat. Fifty for SKY, subdued celebrations
Shortish wide ball is slapped to long-off
More pace on now, Hardik unbothered. Slaps a short, wide ball between SKY's feet at the non-striker's. Arrows at the ball as it races to the boundary again
Pitched right up. Looked like Hardik could've gotten underneath it but he decides to gently punch it to long-on
Flicks it off a length to deep fine leg
Another pull, another four. Short and around chest height, ample time for Hardik to biff it into the ground. Looksmaxes by striding forward
He's on a mission. Pulls it through cow corner and points intently wile tracking the ball. Read the short ball early and whacked it along the ground
Looks slow. Length on leg, flicked to long leg
Slower length ball down leg. Beats the fine leg. SKY was flabberg'd as that wasn't given wide at first.
No pace on the bouncer but SKY upper-cuts it over the keeper's head anyway. Over the stumps, SKY got low and seemed to ramp the bat above his head
Slugged over deep midwicket. Slot ball on middle and leg. Line was the bigger issue as it came into Hardik's arc. Successful over ends costing 22
Tight call for wide goes in the batter's favour. Wide length ball, Hardik looks to slap it and misses
Muscle Pandya's back with peak clarity. Length ball just outside off, 88ks with a bit of turn and good bounce. Hardik uses the bounce to flat-bat it straight of long-on

Nearly gone first ball... Parag runs back from cover but has too much distance to cover. He was on the run, facing the crowd, while reaching forward trying to take the catch. Ball hit his hands and fell forward and Parag went on to tumble.

Last high ball: over the sightscreen, this high ball: short leg. Jurel used multiple lifetimes to run forward, settle underneath and take it fingers pointing up. Was a wide fullish legbreak again but this one turned away. Took the bottom of the bat and Punja breaks a key partnership
Swiped over the sightscreen. High but looked six right off the bat. Touch fuller and wider than the last ball, Jacks effectively swept that on the rise with a stretched bat
Over-hits. Wanted to go inside out over cover, plinks it off the inside-half to long-on. Shot was on as it was looped, fullish and wide
Back of length just outside off, cut to point
Cutter or knuckle ball? Definitely slow. Fullish just outside off, pushed to cover. 111ks, no replay of the hands
Shortish and wide, cut to deep point
Length on middle and leg, SKY stays square-on and flicks to deep midwicket
Pitched up on off, driven to long-off
Cut in half, surprisingly doesn't take the edge. Length ball landed on off and collapsed over leg stump after Jacks got down and looked to drive through cover
Bad ball, SKY looks to cut but there's no room. His back leg moving across didn't help. Short ball just outside off.
Wide and loopy, slapped to long-off. Length ball delivered from wide of the crease, turned away a touch
Could've been four but SKY finds short third to the right. Wide and a touch short, 94ks, he got across and cut it from deep in the crease
Wide and fullish, chomped to backward point
Slog swept with panache. SKY whacks it and rises to see it sail over midwicket. Legbreak on a fullish length on off stump, hit 74 metres far
Wide on a length, cut to deep cover
Jacks on the back foot again. Back of a length, spinning into the stumps, and he flicks this down to cow corner
On a length at the stumps. Jacks drives this down to deep extra cover
On the back foot to drive this down to deep cover. Was on a length at the stumps, he read this one early
Top edge runs down to long stop! In fact, it's almost perfectly perpendicular to the crease. Jacks goes for the reverse sweep, and Jadeja grimaces at his luck
On a length at the pads, flicked down to deep midwicket
SKY reminds us the match is not over yet... The ball was perfectly okay on a length, at the stumps. He shuffles into the leg side, down the pitch, and inside-out lofts this over deep extra cover
Huge swipe across the line and over cow corner! Was in the slot outside off, he reaches out for this one and times the bones out of it
Outsdie off on a fifth-stump line, driven out to deep cover

Brijesh isn't having a great time in the field... Punja speared this one in the blockhole, outside off. SKY goes for a flick but places this straight to Brijesh. Gets both hands on it but can't hold on... Was a regulation catch, but he dropped it
Punja's a smart spinner, and it shows. Was wayyyy outside off. SKY reaches out for a huge cut, away from his body, can't lay bat on ball
Cut right into the turf! Was on a length outside off, but hit straight to point
Driven out to deep cover. Back of a length and just bunts a drive along the ground
Driven out to deep extra cover, enough time to come back for the second. Was on a length outside off
In the air for a bit, but falls safely in front of extra cover. Gripped in the surface on a length, outside off, same pace as the previous two balls: 93 clicks
On a length at the stumps, pulls this one back. Driven out to covers
SKY has absolutely bollocked this one! Was in the slot, on the stumps. SKY opens up his front foot, shuffles into the leg side, and just bashes this one down the ground
Back of a length and spinning into Jacks, who flicks this down to deep midwicket
On a length outside off. Defended out to deep extra cover
Clobbered down to deep extra cover. Lands this delivery, but it's unfortunately right in the slot outside off. Gets the treatment it deserves
Brijesh isn't landing them at the moment. Low full toss on the pads, flicked down to deep midwicket

Everyone's intent on going off in a stretcher here... In fact, this is quite ugly, SKY is on the ground. Another full toss, SKY goes down on one knee and just clobbers an edge right into his helmet here. He's back on his feet, so that's good news! Getting checked by the physio as we stop play
Will Jacks clobbered on the knuckles, that isn't pretty. A beamer right into his chest, he swats this away to fine leg but that has to hurt...
And Jacks has glided this down to deep backward point! Was back of a length, gave Jacks the time he needed to open the face of his blade outside off, and just place this past point
Drives at this full delivery, on a fifth-stump line. Straight to point

Brijesh has made up for that missed throw, and how! He has speared this in full-ish, outside off. Ball jags back in and scoots past Tilak's flick. Kept low, surprises him. His stumps have flown out of the ground and he purses his lips, surprised
Back of a length and rises at Tilak! Takes the edge as it dribbles out to cover, Tilak runs to the other end
Archer is just not letting them get away. Attacking the stumps on a length. Tilak flicks this straight to midwicket
Flicked down to midwicket. Was on a length, outside off, and drives this along the ground
Defended once more. Was on a length otuside off, SKY checked his drive and it floated in the air towards mid-off
At the stumps on an attacking length once more, but not much movement now. Flicked down to square leg
Archer back for a third and begins with a great length, outside off. Defended towards mid-on
An exhibition here. He jumps on one leg and flicks a full ball, outside off, own to deep midwicket. Flashed off his blade
SKY has come to party today. He shuffles into the off side. Perfectly okay delivery outside off. He just waits, and waits, then lofts this down to long leg. A lateeee flick, trademark Surya shovel
Full and on the stumps, bunted down to deep square leg. Takes off, immediately, for the other end
Speared in full, outside off. Defended back to the bowler

Sooryavanshi is ecstatic, and why not! Rickelton doesn't survive too long. He's wafted at this from outside off, on a length, and straight to square leg. Rickelton couldn't get under this and timed it straight to Vaibhav. First IPL catch for Sooryavanshi.

Yes and no and somehow RR make a meal of this easy chance! What was happening, poor cricket all around. On a length and moving away off the stumps. SKY plays this to square leg and takes off, a rather poor call. He realises this and runs back, Rickelton was wayyy out of his crease. Brijesh Sharma can't get a direct hit here, and the bowler  wasn't backing up
Can't time this bunt, but gets it down to midwicket anyway. Was on a length at the stumps. Slower 'un at 123.8 kph is what confused SKY's timing
Now he misses this one. Quite wide outside off, on a length, just jags away from SKY's waft away from his body

And he's just helped this one along the way. Archer was going full, into his pads. But SKY just moves into the off side, manufactures a late swipe down to deep fine leg. Impeccable movement at the crease

Archer, the bowler you are! What a delivery. Naman Dhir looks to go for a huge swipe across the line. He misses this all ends up, and the ball runs straight through and rips out middle stump. Just bamboozled Naman with that one, ball jagged in while in the air, then moved out after pitching

And this edge has flown down to deep third! Was quite short, Naman took his eyes off the ball as he shuffled into the leg side and swiped across the line. Caught the top edge, moral W for Archer there
Flicked down to long-on. Was quite full and on the pads
Back of a length and moving into the pads. Jumps on top of this one, flicks it down to deep square leg
This is even better! In the slot on the stumps. Rickelton just reaches out with his long levers and bashes this down the ground, shot drawn out - straight as an arrow - with a ruler
And now Rickelton hammers a cracking drive down to covers! Was on a length but sitting up wide of off. Rickelton just reaches out, still in his crease, and drives this on the up
French cut to Archer, down at fine leg. Was on a length and Rickelton goes for an expansive cut, inside edges this, almost onto his stumps
Back of a length and closer to the outside-off line. Naman bunts this one close to his body, down to mid-off
Almost another edge! Back of a length, way outside off and moving away from Naman, who goes for a nothing cut away from his body
Brilliant over, this. Spears this one into the blockhole, and Rickelton can only edge a defense into his pads
Back of a length, flicked off the pads and down to square leg

But now Rohit falls for the trap! Archer spears it in even closer to the stumps, moves away off a great length once more. Edged back to Jurel, ball was 145 clicks and Rohit has to walk back for a zero. He just couldn't resist the lose drive away from his body
Rohit lets this one go. Was on a length outside off, tempting him and moving away. Rohit wise to Archer's trap there
Big waft outside off but does not connect. Was a loose ball outside off, moving away further, but not punished
Archer spears one in full, catches the outside edge on Rohit's flick! Dribbles down to point
